def left_counts(frame):
    rows = frame.ascii.split('\n')
    b = sum(1 for r in rows if r and r[0]=='B')
    w = sum(1 for r in rows if r and r[0]=='W')
    return b,w

b,w = left_counts(current_frame)
print('Start B,W',b,w)
# loop until no W left
while True:
    b,w = left_counts(current_frame)
    if w==0:
        break
    # find any M node
    ms = [n for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='M']
    if not ms:
        print('No M found')
        break
    # click first M
    m = ms[0]
    row,col = m['boundary'][0]
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':row,'col':col}])
    # after action, loop continues
print('Finished. B,W', left_counts(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
